summary.text: Richard Westman is the incumbent state senator for the Lamoille District and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election as a Republican and Democratic candidate.
A former state tax commissioner, he served in the Vermont House of Representatives from 1982 to 2009 and has been in the Senate since 2011.

paragraphs.text: Westman graduated from Lamoille Union High School in 1977 and earned a degree from Johnson State College in 1982.
When he was elected to the Senate he was Vermont's Commissioner of Taxes, and he had previously served as director of the Vermont Higher Education Investment Plan.
In the House, Westman was assistant majority leader from 1989 to 1992 and minority leader from 1993 to 1996.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Economic Development, Housing and General Affairs Committee and the Senate Transportation Committee, which he chairs.
